facilities.name: Öppen raststuga, Risön
facilities.description: Open rest/overnight cabin with two beds, electric heat and no cooking. Shared endpoint service with Etapp 12 and Floranslingan; dedupe by source URL/coordinate.

facilities.name: Vatten, Risön
facilities.description: Seasonal tap on the wall of one building at Risön; water is on from 1 May to 31 October / May-October. Shared endpoint service with Etapp 12 and Floranslingan.

facilities.name: Torrtoalett, Risön
facilities.description: Public dry toilet at Risön. Keep separate from bookable indoor WC/showers in the rental accommodation context. Shared endpoint service with Etapp 12 and Floranslingan.

facilities.name: Rastplats, Risön
facilities.description: Risön is the start farm/rest spot for Etapp 13 with outdoor visitor services. Indoor lodging/kitchen/showers are bookable amenities and are not public trail facilities.

facilities.name: Grillplats, Risön
facilities.description: Outdoor grill/fireplace at Risön. Florarna reserve rules allow fires only at prepared places and current fire-risk rules still apply.

facilities.name: Tältplats, Risön
facilities.description: Public tenting possibility at Risön, distinct from bookable indoor lodging. Shared endpoint service with Etapp 12 and Floranslingan.

facilities.name: Grillplats, Finnsjön
facilities.description: Prepared fireplace at the Finnsjön rest area. Naturkartan's current June 2025 notice says firewood is in a wood box 600 m west along the trail, away from the lake, and signs are planned.

facilities.name: Rastplats, Finnsjön
facilities.description: Rest area with bench and lake view in the northern part of Finnsjön, where the trail leaves the lakeside path.

facilities.name: Toalett, Lövstabruk
facilities.description: Shared Lövstabruk endpoint service from the Etapp 14 object page; relevant to Etapp 13 finish and must be deduplicated with Etapp 14. Listed as available May-October with opening-hour variation.

facilities.name: Vatten, Lövstabruk
facilities.description: Shared Lövstabruk endpoint drinking-water service from the Etapp 14 object page. Seasonal May-October with opening-hour variation; dedupe with Etapp 14.

facilities.name: Badplats, Södra Bruksdammen
facilities.description: Endpoint bathing place near road 76/Lövstabruk, supported by Tierp municipality with jetty, diving tower, grill, tables/benches and safety equipment. Coordinate is municipal bathing-place coordinate rather than a Naturkartan object.

facilities.name: Lövstabruk bruksmiljö
facilities.description: Stage endpoint in the historic Lövstabruk ironworks environment with manor, workers' houses, church, offices, dams and preserved 1700s mill setting. Use one heritage POI rather than importing each visitor attraction separately.

facilities.name: Nybron och gamla banvallen mot Lövstabruk
facilities.description: Route-feature POI at the old railway embankment turn described in official prose. Coordinate is snapped to the GPX around the route-text location near Nybron, not to a separately verified heritage marker.
